preconditions.description: The input values L and R must be integers within the range 1 to 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.startswith('YES') and 2 <= n <= 32 and 1 <= m <= n*(n-1)//2)
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to find a (L, R)-continuous city, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by valid n and m values.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i < b_i <= n and 1 <= c_i <= 10**6 for a_i, b_i, c_i in roads)
postconditions.description: All roads must have valid block indices and lengths within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: all(L <= length <= R for length in path_lengths) and len(path_lengths) == R - L + 1
postconditions.description: All path lengths from block 1 to block n must be between L and R, and there must be exactly R - L + 1 unique path lengths.
